hypotheses.title: Acute 30D vs 10D Volatility Term Structure Backwardation Reversion (option8 + model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Captures acute near-term panic where 10-day implied volatility blows out above 30-day baseline into steep backwardation. Conditioned on fundamental corporate cashflow generation under industry neutralization, extracting recovery alpha as panic resolves.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails when inverted short-term term structures correctly anticipate persistent corporate insolvency.

hypotheses.title: Parkinson Intraday Volatility Noise Spread Fading (option8 + model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Parkinson volatility measures intraday high-low whipsaw while historical volatility measures close-to-close institutional commitment. Fading acute intraday noise relative to realized close-to-close volatility on cashflow compounders captures liquidity provision returns.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during momentum trend days where wide intraday high-low spreads mark the start of multi-week directional trends.

hypotheses.title: Rank-Neutral Low-Beta Defensive Quality (model51 + model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Pure rank-based formulation of the Low-Beta anomaly. Eliminates weight concentration by using cross-sectional ranking across all 3,000 instruments, systematically longing defensive compounders and shorting volatile lottery stocks.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms during speculative liquidity expansions where junk high-beta equities outperform stable compounders.
